# id: # Selectors are the optional package sets bootstrap.sh can install on top of
# the base profile. The predicate says which machines the selector applies to,
# in terms of hardware facts (see hardware-facts.example); an empty predicate
# means "any machine". Grammar, evaluated left to right with && binding
# tighter than ||:  key=value  key!=value  key~word  (word in a space list).
# A selector whose predicate fails is not offered, and an explicit request for
# it exits 3 with the reason — never a silent no-op.
